tasks.title: Prepare ongoing incremental sync implementation slice
tasks.summary: Add durable changed-file queueing, read-only per-entry queue listing, explicit failed-terminal queue review state, bounded and foreground local incremental execution, foreground OS watcher execution, profile-enabled foreground-daemon local polling sync, bounded and foreground profile-backed network queue execution, profile-enabled source-side foreground-daemon network polling sync, and compact report/status visibility before the remaining LAN-discovery-gated network and per-entry transport slices.
notes: Implemented before this task: repeated `push` runs can publish changed snapshots.

Implemented in current slices: `sync queue` durable enqueue/status/list/ready/cancel/fail, read-only per-entry queue detail, explicit failed-terminal operator review state with `failed_at` evidence, `sync run` bounded local scan/enqueue/publish pass, foreground local `sync loop` polling with generated session IDs and optional `--max-runs`, foreground OS watcher `sync watch` with baseline and coalesced event run receipts plus optional `--max-events`, bounded profile-backed `sync network run` with pre-mutation network material validation, receiver-side network-transfer evidence, idle not-attempted output, and retry/backoff on runtime network refusal, foreground profile-backed `sync network loop` with generated session IDs, optional `--max-runs`, idle not-attempted passes, and the same retry/backoff behavior, profile-enabled foreground-daemon local polling sync via `sync.local_polling`, daemon restart acceptance for fresh local polling run receipts, profile-enabled source-side foreground-daemon network polling sync via `sync.network_polling`, foreground process restart sequence recovery from existing durable local and network run receipts, durable run receipts, `in_flight`/`done`/`backoff`/`failed` status accounting, retry backoff on refused publish, stale in-flight requeue before a new pass, hidden-file/dot-directory queue coverage, and report/status aggregation for queue/run receipt counts plus malformed queue/run artifact problems.
Remaining closure after T-001: LAN-discovery-gated network changed-file sync and per-entry network transport.
DAG dependency: depends on agent daemon lifecycle and broad network recovery acceptance.
Non-goal: bidirectional sync or conflict semantics beyond one-way migration.

tasks.title: Wire LAN-discovery-gated network changed-file sync
tasks.summary: Add a bounded `sync network discover-run` pass that uses low-information LAN discovery as an availability gate only: a non-ambiguous candidate must match the profile-selected `network.receiver_url` before the existing profile-pinned mTLS network queue pass runs.

last_gate_commands.command: TMPDIR=$PWD/.tmp/testtmp GOTMPDIR=$PWD/.tmp/go-build GOCACHE=$PWD/.tmp/gocache go mod tidy -diff

notes: Must preserve discovery-is-not-trust: LAN browse candidates are availability hints only; profile trust and pinned mTLS remain the transfer boundary.
Must keep profile as SSOT; do not add endpoint/runtime overrides for sync behavior.
Must keep current sync.network_polling as implemented source-side worker-only network polling, not relabel it as LAN-discovery-gated sync.
A failed discovery gate must write no queue/run receipt and must not mutate profile receiver_url.

tasks.title: Add per-entry network transport for queued changes
tasks.summary: Move beyond whole-profile/root push --network delegation so queued changed-file entries can be transported and receipted at per-entry granularity.
notes: Must not weaken target preflight, path safety, profile trust, hidden-file handling, or durable queue/run receipt evidence.
Must keep bounded network run/loop and sync.network_polling docs honest until per-entry transport is actually wired.
